patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with light grey and deep navy backgrounds, containing content centered within a consistent max-width.
Prominent, bold, uppercase headings for main section titles, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text for detailed explanations.
Strategic use of a vibrant blue for calls-to-action and key highlighted text, providing strong contrast against a palette of light grey and deep navy.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, maintaining constant access to site navigation.
Each major content block is introduced with a large, bold heading and often includes a supporting illustration or data visualization, clearly segmenting information.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar is implemented as a sticky header, ensuring it remains visible and accessible at all scroll depths.
Visual separation between content sections is achieved by alternating full-width background colors between a light grey and a deep navy blue.
Key information and calls-to-action are highlighted using a vibrant brand blue, creating strong visual anchors and guiding user attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, uppercase headings are significantly larger than body text (e.g., hero heading is ~4-5x body text size), with a clear hierarchy established through size and weight.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (buttons and cards have slightly rounded corners)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with ample vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel, especially in the hero.

standout: The site effectively uses a strong, consistent brand blue as a primary accent color, particularly for calls to action and key highlighted text, which pops against the alternating light grey and deep navy backgrounds. The abstract, line-art style illustrations in the hero and other sections provide a modern, tech-focused feel without being overly complex.
